page.overview:
What is Four Seas?

The are four bodies of water surrounding the Eastern Continent which are each ruled by a Dragon King

The Four Seas historically referred to the 4 major seas at the boundaries of the Han dynasty after conquering the Xiongnu:

In literature, they are used to refer to the four cardinal boundaries of the world
